packages.title: Environment Agency Pollution Inventory, National Data Library — scope and status QA
facts: The Environment Agency Pollution Inventory record was last updated on 17 April 2026.
It provides annual mass releases of specified substances to air, controlled waters and sewers plus off-site waste transfers from regulated large industrial sites.
The current record exposes downloadable data for years 2013 to 2024.
Reporting covers the whole authorisation or permit including point and fugitive sources.
Facility or permit-level releases must not be silently attributed to individual land parcels.
